meta.units: number of CONTRACTS (not rupees; lot sizes differ per underlying and change over time, so counts are not comparable across underlyings nor summable to notional)
meta.grain: one row per (session date, participant); participants = Client / DII / FII / Pro

definitions.net_fut_index: Future Index Long − Future Index Short (contracts). Negative = net short.
definitions.ls_fut_index: Future Index Long ÷ Future Index Short. Preferred over the net for cross-time comparison because total open interest grows over the years.
definitions.net_fut_stock: Future Stock Long − Future Stock Short (single-stock futures).
definitions.net_opt_index: (Call Long + Put Short) − (Call Short + Put Long) — a crude bullish-direction proxy, NOT a delta (this report carries no strikes).
definitions.net_total: Total Long Contracts − Total Short Contracts, as published.

caveats: Index-futures net short is routinely a HEDGE against cash longs, not a bearish bet — a large negative net_fut_index alongside cash buying is ordinary book-keeping.
The F&O 'FII' participant category is not identical to the FPI registration universe behind the cash and shareholding data: related populations, not the same one.
Contract counts, not notional. Read direction and ratio, not magnitude alone.
Descriptive positioning context, not a validated signal (house rule).
